title: Jobs
description: The job queue. One row per job; the brief, report and review live in jobs/<id>/. A job in progress is a remote branch job/<id>; `done` on main means reviewed and merged. Ids are one capital letter and a number (J, W, ...: `[jobs] id_prefix` in wsc.toml names the repo's letter). Rules for picking up and reviewing: `wsc jobs`, docs/CONSUMING.md 'The job pipeline'.

description.description: the scope in one or two lines (what a brief must cover)

status.description: fix: a review round asked for changes; only a reviewer sets it

model.description: opus only with the reason in the brief

semver.description: the release level the job's merge asks for (W29, C27: the release workflow owns VERSION); required from status queued on for ids at or above [jobs] semver_from; none = no release
